The '''Harch''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Spider/Legends|arachnid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Secundus Ando/Legends|Secundus Ando]].

==Biology==
[[File:AdmiralTrench-TCWs2BR3.png|thumb|left|180px|Admiral Trench.]]
The Harch possessed a large-[[Tooth/Legends|fanged]] [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] between two prominent [[Wikipedia:Chelicerae|chelicerae]], above which they had six [[red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] arranged in a semicircle. The two lowest eyes were larger and roughly twice the size of the four smaller eyes. Harch walked on two [[Limb/Legends|legs]] and had six arms, with the second and third set of arm protruding from behind the first pair rather than directly above or below them. These arms were covered in thick [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and ended in three-fingered hands. The Harch were distantly related to the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and there was much debate among [[Geneticist/Legends|geneticists]] regarding the relationship between the Harch and the Aqualish [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]]. However, the Harch themselves considered such discussions to be obscene.<ref name="Warfare" />

==History==
The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] named [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] was a member of this species.

During the last century of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Harch ruling nests allied themselves against the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]].<ref name="Warfare" />

Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Harch raiders fought against the new regime during the [[Noolian Crisis]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].<ref name="Warfare" />
